title: Heavy Blueprint tick or VM script execution
fix_rationale: The trace shows Blueprint bytecode or event execution taking significant GameThread time. Disabling unnecessary actor ticks, lowering tick rates, or migrating heavy logic to C++ mitigates the cost.
evidence_template: {timer} spent {ms} ms executing Blueprint bytecode across game actors ({share}% of excess time).

fixes.text: Disable 'Start with Tick Enabled' on actors and components that do not need continuous updates; switch to event-driven logic or timers.
Increase Tick Interval (e.g. SetActorTickInterval(0.1)) for non-critical gameplay updates.
Profile specific Blueprint graphs and rewrite math-heavy calculation loops in C++.

verify: Re-capture the trace and confirm that ProcessEvent and Blueprint function times decrease.
